latestVersion.changelog:
podcast-pipeline v1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive podcast production assistant skill.
- Supports three modes: Interview Prep, Post-Recording (show notes & social content), and Solo Episode Planning.
- Produces research briefs, interview question sets, guest prep emails, show notes, social media posts, YouTube descriptions, and episode outlines.
- Automatically detects the appropriate workflow from user requests, with minimal follow-up questions.
- Clear, structured outputs for easy copy-paste and use.
